verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a customer data platform, but the evidence shows no first-party feature for running workspace actions from plain-language commands. The "Open in ChatGPT/Claude" doc buttons only hand documentation to external assistants. The vague "AI-powered audiences" marketing line and the Public API are adjacent features or developer building blocks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
